sheets.title: MECHANICAL ABBREVIATIONS AND LEGEND
sheets.reading_notes: Full mechanical legend and symbol schedule. Confirms HVAC/plumbing symbol set: radiators, fire dampers, VBA plenum boxes, SFCD registers, LG exhaust registers, F51 125/160 registers. Adserballe & Knudsen / Hollingsworth Pack joint venture noted in title block. USACE stamp visible. Contract W912DS-23F0086.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL HVAC PLAN - LEVEL 1
sheets.reading_notes: Level 1 HVAC plan at 1:100. 19 bays shown across the long building. Each bedroom shown with supply plenum box (A-type, 80 m³/h) and bathroom exhaust register (B-type, 75 m³/h). Corridor exhaust indicated. Central AHU connections visible at mechanical room (Room 113). Motorized control dampers in vertical duct runs. Laundry room 110 and kitchen 112B noted with exhaust connections. Dryer exhaust noted separate. Entry vestibules E101/E102/E103, Stair 1/2/3, MECH 113, ELEC 115. 3 exterior entry points south side. Ductwork runs primarily in corridor ceiling. All ducts Lindab safe (LINDAB brand) except dryer exhaust (LINDAB transfer type). 500 mm silencers at AHU connections. Motorized dampers in vertical rises are 125Ø at most branch runs.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL HVAC PLAN - LEVEL 2
sheets.reading_notes: Level 2 HVAC plan at 1:100. Identical layout to Level 1 except: TELECOM room 213 replaces MECH room; Room 212 is MULTIPURPOSE (kitchen/dining area). Corridor C200. Exhaust continues from bathrooms (75 m³/h) and bedrooms (supply 80 m³/h). Corner rooms at ends of building show D-type supply (250 m³/h) for larger return. Same motorized damper vertical risers. Laundry 210, Kitchen 212B.

sheets.title: MECHANICAL ABBREVIATIONS AND LEGEND (revised)
sheets.reading_notes: Revised legend sheet; essentially same content as M-001 with updated revision date 2026-02-06. Minor updates to legend only.

sheets.title: PLUMBING ABBREVIATIONS, LEGENDS, AND SCHEDULES
sheets.reading_notes: Plumbing fixture connection schedule shows: 54 lavatories (Hansgrohe VVS NR. 70213710 4), 54 showers (stainless), 54 water closets (Duravit), 3 utility sinks, 12 washing machines (Bosch 300 series), 3 dishwashers, 3 kitchen sinks (Lavabo Kubus 020), 3 floor drains. Backflow preventer schedule: BFP-1, domestic CW supply, RZBP, 100MM, in MECH 113. Hot water storage tank schedule: HT-1,2,3, 500L each, tank temp 62°C, inlet/outlet 55MM. Slope table for horizontal drain piping: exterior 42mm/m (1/2"), 75-160mm pipe 11mm/m, smaller 21mm/m. Note to refer to mechanical drawings for pump and heat exchanger schedules.

sheets.title: UTILITY CRAWL SPACE PLUMBING PLAN
sheets.reading_notes: Crawl space (under-building) sanitary plan at 1:100. 19 columns of drain drop locations. 110mm diameter sanitary drains from each bathroom stack down through crawl space. Drains combine at two 160mm mains that run to 'TO MAIN SEWER' at north end of building, exiting at columns 5-6 and 16-17. Yard cleanouts (YCO) provided at each drain run. Notes confirm pre-insulated PE pipe with double heat-traced jacketing for all exterior/under-floor piping. Minimum 2% slope for exterior. Piping material: PE pressure pipe with polyurethane foam insulation and spiral hot galvanized outer casing.

conflict_flags.rationale: The RFP 99% criterion and the design analysis extreme design temperature serve different purposes. BFA applied -40°C for equipment sizing (worst-case), consistent with UFC 3-130-07 Arctic construction practice. The -29°F is the statistical ASHRAE 99% bin temperature; -40°C is the extreme or 99.6% value consistent with Pituffik data. Not a true conflict — two different design temperature standards.
